text:
mina: CI nightly e2e perf gate just failed — p95 up ~2.3x and mixedseq throughput dropped ~18% (test id nightly-2468). anyone available for a quick bisect/replay?
infra-bot: buildkite: job nightly-2468 FAILED · p95_latency > threshold · logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly-2468 · artifacts attached
sanjay: on it — kicking off a replay with the same seed + collecting the perf traces. tagging @tj for infra checks.
tj: saw a small GPU queue spike around 02:05 UTC, but pools are healthy now. will watch autoscaler logs.
lucia: FYI i landed batching heuristic tweak in PR #3421 yesterday — could be related. happy to run a revert on canary if needed.
mina: can infra-bot replay with seed 202803 and enable verbose tracing? command we usually use:
```
infra replay nightly-2468 --seed=202803 --tracing=perf,kv --output=tmp/replay-202803
```
qa-bot: replay job started: nightly-2468-replay-202803 · ETA ~12m · link: https://ci.internal/replays/nightly-2468-replay-202803
sanjay: if replay still fails, propose a quick two-commit bisect between a1b2c3..d4e5f6: candidates: fb7c0fa (batching heuristic) and c9d2b11 (kv-cache touch).
tj: gathering autoscaler + queue histograms now. also requesting per-model seq len histogram from seqhist tool: `/infra/tools/seqhist --job nightly-2468 --bucket=50`
lucia: I'll schedule a canary revert of the batching tweak for the canary pool and run a smoke e2e there once replay completes.
mina: adding a note in issue #perf-regressions/2468 with current triage steps. please drop short status updates here so we have a timeline. :raised_hands:
sanjay: replay finished — traces uploaded to tmp/replay-202803 · initial look: p95 still high but latency source looks like increased decode time for longseqs. sharing flame link in thread.
tj: autoscaler showed a 15s burst where new instances registered slowly — could amplify decode delays under concurrent runs.
lucia: ran quick revert on canary and kicked a smoke run — preliminary: p95 back to baseline on canary. looks like batching heuristic is the likely suspect.
mina: great signal. sanjay, can you open a rollback PR for fb7c0fa and land canary->staging rollback if smoke passes?
sanjay: will open PR and request quick review from lucia. tagging @infra-oncall to monitor.
mina: thanks everyone — will follow up in the issue with final action (rollback + postmortem). if anything changes ping me, otherwise i'll close the triage loop in ~2h.
